commands.description: One batched read of host, OS, uptime, load, CPU counters, memory, disks and reboot flag and the names of unhealthy containers (empty if docker is absent). Sections start with a '##name' line.
commands.script: echo '##hostname'; hostname; echo '##os'; cat /etc/os-release; echo '##uptime'; cat /proc/uptime; echo '##loadavg'; cat /proc/loadavg; echo '##nproc'; nproc; echo '##stat'; head -1 /proc/stat; echo '##meminfo'; grep -E '^(MemTotal|MemAvailable):' /proc/meminfo; echo '##df'; df -P -B1 -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay 2>/dev/null; echo '##reboot'; if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; echo '##security'; apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | grep -c -E '^[^/ ]+/[^ ]*-security'; echo '##unhealthy'; docker ps --filter health=unhealthy --format '{{.Names}}' 2>/dev/null

commands.description: All containers (docker ps -a) plus one-shot resource stats for running ones. Compose stacks are derived from container labels.
commands.script: echo '##docker'; if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ok; else echo missing; fi; echo '##ps'; docker ps -a --format '{{json .}}' 2>&1; echo '##stats'; docker stats --no-stream --format '{{json .}}' 2>&1

commands.description: docker start one container. {id} must match ^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$.
docker stop one container. {id} must match ^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$.
docker restart one container. {id} must match ^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$.
Follow one container's logs, starting with the last 100 lines. Run over a pseudo-terminal on its own connection; stop by sending Ctrl-C. {id} must match ^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$.
Packages apt can upgrade (from the local package cache; no root, no network), held packages, when the cache was last refreshed, and whether a reboot is pending.
commands.script: echo '##apt'; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ok; else echo missing; fi; echo '##upgradable'; apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null; echo '##held'; apt-mark showhold 2>/dev/null; echo '##refreshed'; stat -c %Y /var/lib/apt/periodic/update-success-stamp 2>/dev/null || stat -c %Y /var/lib/apt/lists 2>/dev/null; echo '##reboot'; if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi

commands.description: docker compose pull for one stack: downloads newer images, changes no containers. {project} must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$. {dir} and {file} are absolute paths from the project's compose labels, single-quoted for the shell (' becomes '\'').

docker compose up -d for one stack: recreates only containers whose image or config changed, starts stopped ones. {project} must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$. {dir} and {file} are absolute paths from the project's compose labels, single-quoted for the shell (' becomes '\'').

docker compose up -d --force-recreate for one stack: recreates every container. {project} must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$. {dir} and {file} are absolute paths from the project's compose labels, single-quoted for the shell (' becomes '\'').
